references.notes: Firefly Contractors & Design — the canonical MLA reference for roofing / home services. Everything about this site (fixed section order, two-column hero with calendar, editorial two-tone eyebrow + serif H2s, service tiles with background image + Learn More button, cyan #00cfd1 accent, WhyChooseUs dark-band with CSS-mask icons, UsVsThem with overlay labels + check/X grid, service page with SEO H1 + sub-services bullets, /book page with calendar + What's next info column) is the pattern. Clone this before anything else.
references.note_url_fragility: This URL may move when the site is attached to a permanent domain. If the URL 404s, cross-reference the template repo directly at ai-website-builder/astro-templates/firefly/ for the current shape.

references.notes: The default template, and the structural reference for every new site. Section order: hero (full-bleed media + floating quote card) → promise bar → services grid with category labels + sub-service lists → testimonials → promise band → signature system (intro + sub-blocks + numbered steps + guarantee) → 4-step process strip on a dark band → about with checklist → long-form SEO body with a second checklist → FAQ → recent-articles row → closing CTA. READ THE LOCAL TEMPLATE, not a third-party site: the structure is already encoded here, it costs nothing to read, and it cannot drift or 404. Deliberately absent by design: sticky side-rail quote tab, floating quote popup, video-testimonial blocks. Structure is reusable; COPY IS NOT. Branded program names — any named 'system', 'guarantee' or 'promise' block — belong to whoever coined them and must never reach a generated site. Every component here is content-driven and ships no default copy, so each client supplies its own naming.

AGC Concrete — original inspiration for the editorial type treatment, section rhythm, and real-photography approach. Use as backup reference when Firefly's URL is unreachable or when a client wants a distinctly editorial aesthetic vs Firefly's brighter cyan-accented direction.

anti_patterns: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
